title: A hap that drops on a later cycle
teaches: The compile dry-run checks cycle 0, so a hap expression that only fails later still loads. At frame time the failed hap is dropped and the write is omitted for that cycle; the other pattern tracks keep writing.
observe: At cycle 0 the drop lane writes 1 / -720720.
At cycle 1, tick = 720720, the division fails, and drop is omitted.
steady still writes 0.5 on that frame.
At cycle 2 the same formula writes a positive value again.
